names.zh: 吉尔苏／特罗法军战役出土组合（Parrot 1948 综述）

summary.zh: Parrot 对 1877–1933 年特罗战役史与已刊发现类别的综合；具体雕像/铭文应回查原报告与馆藏，本记录不编造 AO 号。
summary.en: Parrot’s synthesis of 1877–1933 Tello campaign history and published find classes; specific statues/inscriptions must be rechecked in original reports and museum catalogs — no invented AO numbers.
